newsitem.title: USA: Staples, Office Depot delay meetings.
newsitem.headline: Staples, Office Depot delay meetings.

text.p: Staples Inc and Office Depot Inc said on Wednesday they intend to delay their special shareholder meetings for a merger vote that were originally scheduled for February 27 until 0900 EST on March 7.

The office supply retailers are awaiting a ruling from the U.S. Federal Trade Commission about the merger that would form a company with $10 billion in annual revenues with 1,100 locations, the companies said.
Staples and Office Depot said on February 17, 1997 that they agreed with the Federal Trade Commission to extend the Hart-Scott-Rodino antitrust waiting period to March 5, 1997.
The extension was to allow the companies to provide more information to the agency, the companies said.
